messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 14):
"""
The PMC shall be constituted with Appointed Actuary (AA), Chief Marketing / Distribution Officer, Chief Investment Officer, Chief Technology Officer, and Chief Compliance Officer of the Insurer as members. In addition to the above, the Insurer may include other members of its senior management in the PMC as members or as invitees (refer under 6(1)(b) of IRDAI (Insurance Products) Regulation, 2024). 3. The PMC shall carry out proper due diligence and record its concurrence/sign off on various product related risks (such as risks related to capital requirements, profitability, underwriting, reinsurance etc.) before approval of the product by PMC. 4. The quorum for the PMC shall be three members in addition to Appointed Actuary 5.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"Who must be a member of the Product Management Committee (PMC) as per the IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business?","answer":"The PMC must include the Appointed Actuary, Chief Marketing/Distribution Officer, Chief Investment Officer, Chief Technology Officer, and Chief Compliance Officer of the insurer.","facts":["The PMC shall be constituted with Appointed Actuary (AA), Chief Marketing / Distribution Officer, Chief Investment Officer, Chief Technology Officer, and Chief Compliance Officer of the Insurer as members."]},{"question":"What is the minimum quorum required for a PMC meeting, and how many members does it include?","answer":"The quorum is three members in addition to the Appointed Actuary, making a total of four members required for a quorum.","facts":["The quorum for the PMC shall be three members in addition to Appointed Actuary 5."]}]}
